name: Fiesta Plastics Inc
about:
Fiesta Plastics Inc. opened in 1988 in Mesa, Arizona, when founder Jack Thompson traded the title of his truck for a small injection molding machine after three decades in the plastics industry. Within months the machine was paid off and three more followed, laying the groundwork for a company that has grown steadily for over 30 years.

Today the 20,000-square-foot facility houses 19 injection molding machines ranging from 25 to 650 tons with shot sizes up to 7.5 pounds. The shop processes a wide range of thermoplastics including ABS, acetal, acrylic, HIPS, nylon, polycarbonate, polypropylene, polystyrene, polyurethane, PVC, and TPU. In-house tooling capabilities center on two Fadal high-speed machining centers, supporting mold production from simple mud sets to Class A tools, along with mold maintenance and repair. Product and mold design are handled in SolidWorks 2024, accepting Part, STEP, IGES, and STL files, while rapid prototyping is available via 3D printing in both plastic and metal materials.

The company serves customers needing a complete finished product, from micro-molded components to large complex assemblies. Its blog notes core competencies in mold building, injection molding, assembly, and value-added operations across a variety of part sizes and complexities.

Fiesta Plastics emphasizes a “Never Give Up” motto built on quality at an economical price, continual innovation, customer satisfaction as the top priority, and integrity in every interaction. The firm positions itself as a full-service partner rather than a molding shop alone, handling design, manufacturing, and delivery under one roof.
